correctness.rationale: The graph edge constraints are equivalent to shortest-path Lipschitz inequalities. Conditioning on pole difference h makes m disjoint two-coordinate arms independent. The three-fold convolution of [-1,1] has area 3-h^2 for |h|<=1 and (3-|h|)^2/2 for 1<=|h|<=3, yielding the exact integral and rational formula. A positive two-branch pushforward moment density gives strict Cauchy--Schwarz log-convexity and ratio convergence to support endpoint 3. Beta subtraction has strictly positive integrand, whose linear zero at x=2 supplies the secondary coefficient 3 with O(2^m/m^3) remainder. Gamma-ratio asymptotics give the main expansion. Independent exact Ehrhart leading-coefficient calculations match m=1..7 (dimensions 3..15), while infinite conclusions rely on analysis.

value.rationale: Equal-arm length-three theta graphs are a natural biconnected many-cycle graph metric family, distinct from the complete-bipartite length-two case. The exact anchored dual volume in dimension 2m+1 is a natural functional-analytic invariant; its positive moment density proves a strict all-dimensional ratio law, and a sharp positive 2^m/m^2 correction reveals the interface of two geometric cross-section regimes beyond standard leading Laplace behavior. The theorem covers an infinite family and is not an arbitrary finite index or cosmetic reparameterization.
